statement: A narrow diagnostic marker intent on the existing admin ingress delegates to LogsOwner and writes a fixed schema record to the existing logs system partition through its authoritative gateway. Server node identity and original marker content/time stay fixed across asynchronous work and gateway retries. Identical recorded markers settle retries; conflicting identities refuse without overwrite; unknown or failed observations never prove noncommit. Admin smoke and split-brain probes migrate from raw SQL while retaining logs-p1, local minority ingress, no minority ACK during the fault and post-heal durable marker checks.

constraints.statement: Extend LogsOwner only; fixed marker namespace, fixed level and metadata, body only markerId/message and server-owned node identity. No arbitrary log fields, upsert/overwrite, generic SQL exemption, new state store or competing admin authorization scheme. Retain existing admin ingress trust/auth behavior and trace its actual path.

Capture and freeze request and row before the first await. Existing gateway retry retains write identity and bytes. Read reconciliation uses explicit-success authoritative row observations and exact marker semantic identity; uniqueness at insertion is the mutation-time fence. Different ingress node is a different marker intent and conflicts. Missing/unavailable/read-failed or ambiguous mutation outcomes do not mean not committed.

Migrate smoke and network-partition-split-brain only plus narrow node-handle transport. Keep marker on logs-p1 and originate the fault probe inside the actual isolated node where required. Preserve useful typed refusal/unknown outcomes; a client timeout cannot count as rejected/not committed. Retain post-heal majority presence/minority absence assertions. No synthetic success fallback when a real capability is absent.

Node e701, scale6a228 and the separately prepared case unit remain frozen. No capability retirement, affinity migration or MovieLens journal reset here; those have separate decisions/units. Do not change scheduler, native transaction semantics, production retry/timeouts, baselines or hooks. Independent source review before composition; no main merge/publication.

Seal before production changes; preserve missing-route/raw-admission red. Prove real HTTP -> owner -> gateway -> CDC -> SQLite with exact row, malformed/collision/retry/read-failure outcomes and both actual caller transports. Canonical retries0, thermal and root controller coordination; local boundary proof is not a native cluster partition acceptance claim.
